title: TopoMarket - market structure and early warning research

scenes.picture: GitHub social preview (1280x640) fitted to 16:9 without distortion
scenes.narration: TopoMarket explores how market structure changes under stress and tests whether topology can flag major declines early.

scenes.picture: Structure screen: quiet preset then stress transition preset; synthetic label visible
scenes.narration: Start with twelve industry portfolios. As I move from a quiet window to a stressed one, more industries begin moving together.

scenes.picture: Select an industry, open the Mapper view, highlight a group pair and its shared portfolios
scenes.narration: The correlation map shows which industries move together. Mapper groups them by similar behavior and highlights industries shared between groups.

scenes.picture: Late-warning teaching example alert, shared S&P 500/VIX/score timeline, Takens and H1 explanation
scenes.narration: A separate indicator uses the shape of recent S and P five hundred returns to flag unusual behavior. Here is the alert and the feature behind it.

scenes.picture: Blind Replay at the cutoff, then Reveal: origin close, 10% boundary, lowest close, first breach
scenes.narration: Replay shows when the alert appeared. Revealing the outcome lets us see that the decline had already begun.
scenes.alternate_line_used: late warning (the frozen synthetic showcase has no evaluator-credited TDA alert)

scenes.picture: Validation screen: Experimental market anomaly, metrics, sample size and false-alert rate
scenes.narration: The results show where the signal works and where it misses.

scenes.picture: Static end card with the exact repository URL held for the full five seconds
scenes.narration: Explore the code and the live demo on GitHub.
